items.description: Training or evaluation samples may lack clear source notes.
items.mitigation: Record dataset origin, license, collection date and scope.

items.description: Sentiment model may behave differently across groups.
items.mitigation: Create paired test cases and compare subgroup error rates.

items.description: Document QA inputs may contain names, IDs or invoices.
items.mitigation: Mask personal identifiers and restrict raw document access.

items.description: QA system may answer without sufficient evidence.
items.mitigation: Require evidence spans and allow abstention on weak retrieval.

items.description: External documents may have unclear redistribution rights.
items.mitigation: Store source URLs and avoid redistributing restricted content.

items.description: Users may overtrust saliency or attention explanations.
items.mitigation: Label explanations as diagnostic aids, not causal proof.

items.description: No rollback plan may exist if online quality degrades.
items.mitigation: Record baseline version, adapter version and rollback trigger.

decision.decision_note: Hold release until high-risk items have stronger mitigation evidence and reviewer approval.
